newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres to transfer its stake in ABS-CBN.
newsitem.headline: Benpres to transfer its stake in ABS-CBN.

text.p: Benpres Holdings Corp said on Monday its board decided to recommend to stockholders the transfer of its shares in ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp and SkyVision Corp to Lopez Inc in exchange for a convertible instrument.
It said this was intended to enhance stockholder's value by allowing foreign investors to directly hold Benpres shares.
The company did not give details of the convertible instrument.
Philippine laws bar foreign participation in media companies.

Benpres is largely-owned by the Lopez family. It owns 71 percent of ABS-CBN, which is the most profitable among local television networks. It has a 20 percent stake in SkyVision Corp, a cable television company.
Shareholders will vote on the proposal at the annual meeting scheduled on April 30, the statement said.
